name: Feature request
about: Suggest an idea/improvement for this project
title: feat([SCOPE]/[NAME]

---

**User Story:**
Explain in a user story what you want to implement, who it effects and why its a valuable change to make. 
_ E.g. As a [USER] I want to be able to..._

**Rough Implementation Plan:**
What are the rough steps you plan to take to implement this feature?
_E.g. 

Step 1).  Create new .tsx file for calendar widget in components directory
Step 2).  Hook into API using middleware defined in middleware.ts
Step 3).  Add unit/snapshot tests and alter integration tests for checking calendar widget renders and presents data as expected
_

**Describe alternatives you've considered**
A clear and concise description of any alternative solutions or features you've considered.

**What does successful implementation look like?:**
I.e. How do we verify the change was implemented successfully? Are there additional tests which should pass, or a measurable process speed up in system boot up time etc.


**Additional context:**
Add any other context or screenshots about the feature request here.
